purpose: Source identities and assertion disposition for the Rust tokenizer loading/lifetime replacement; no retired C++ fixture is compiled by Rust tests.

native_reader.boundary: The external GGML reader remains native. Rust owns its metadata context lifetime and all tokenizer intake, replacement and result lifetime.

retained_obligations.original: BPETokenizer is neither copy-constructible nor move-constructible.
retained_obligations.replacement: Identical static_asserts now compile in the actual generated native holder, together with deleted copy/move operations.

retained_obligations.original: Missing file does not create or publish an owner; success loads all token and merge indices including duplicates and releases GGUF metadata.
retained_obligations.replacement: Production Rust Gguf adapter and transactional loader; fake ABI observes exact token/merge read indices, native tiny GGUF confirms duplicate token IDs and successful load without weights.

retained_obligations.original: Failures at new, token insertion, merge insertion and finish release the candidate exactly once, preserve the old pointer, and release metadata.
retained_obligations.replacement: Test-only stage faults exercise the actual loader/new-owner functions and real Box<Owner> Drop counters; each failure compares old pointer, creation/release deltas and metadata open/close totals.

retained_obligations.original: Missing tokens or merges, null token/merge strings and oversized counts fail without replacing the owner.
retained_obligations.replacement: Same-path adapter faults cover each original case, plus wrong array/element types before typed native getters.

retained_obligations.original: Special keys skip missing names, preserve [1,-1,1] signed conversion and request order; direct special spelling/ID and registration failures are surfaced.
retained_obligations.replacement: Rust special intake records exact signed sequence, tests actual registration/encode, and injected rejection. Native tiny GGUF covers UINT32 special fields. ABI status preserves missing-file false versus registration error.

retained_obligations.original: Encoding forwards embedded NUL text and EOS mode; empty results require no data; nonempty results are copied independently.
retained_obligations.replacement: Actual encode_to ABI observes a\0b through known IDs and both EOS modes. Vec storage guarantees a nonnull initialized span whenever count is positive and uses null for empty output.

retained_obligations.original: Null result and null data errors clean up without leaking result storage.
retained_obligations.replacement: Rust never constructs null-result or inconsistent data/count owners: encoding errors return before callback, while copy refusal/missing callback reports failure and releases the real Vec. Test counters verify drops on success, empty output, callback failure and caught safe-Rust unwind.

retained_obligations.original: Successful replacement frees the old owner, permits encoding recovery and balances final owners/results/GGUF contexts.
retained_obligations.replacement: Actual Rust pointer-slot replacement publishes only a finalized Box and drops the displaced Box. Both fake ABI and real tiny GGUF tests retain failure recovery and final drop balances.

qualification_boundary: Focused replacement checks must pass before deleting the three native controls. Full hosted owning-crate build/link, actual pinned vocabulary captures, full-model speech quality, lifecycle, resource and distribution qualification remain pending. The small metadata file is model-free and does not infer.
